title: Ukrainian forces reportedly strike oil facility in Russia's Samara Oblast in overnight attack
summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels reported that Ukrainian drones had struck the Samara Linear Production and Dispatch Station in the city of Prosvet, around 835 kilometers (520 miles) northeast of Ukraine's border.

title: 'Suspicious object' enters Latvian airspace near Belarus, Russia border
summary: Less than an hour after the initial announcement, the Latvian military declared that the incursion had ended and the threat had left.

title: U.S. National Cathedral holds special prayer for Ukrainian children
summary: "Today it is something special because it is about Ukrainian children," Denys Sienik, acting ambassador of Ukraine to the U.S., said. "Those children who are no longer with us, those children who have been kidnapped by Russia. And it is so important to draw attention, to raise public attention to the matter, and to send a message to all Ukrainian children that no one is forgotten."

title: Ukrainian forces evacuate civilians around Kherson Oblast during Oleshky ceasefire
summary: 167 Kherson Oblast residents trapped on the right bank of the Dnipro River were evacuated to safer areas in the region. 22 children and 21 people with limited mobility were among the evacuated, the General Staff said.
